title: Dialogue kept in context
hypothesis: Keeping every dialogue page whole in collapsed tool results, and quoting the dialogue that led to the last story milestone in supervisor briefings, keeps story instructions in front of the model (3f21: MOM's T98 "He lives right next door" was gone from context by the T107 decision, and the T166 stall briefing quoted only the lab scientist's filler), so more runs go next door after Mom's instruction and reach the rival house in fewer turns.
notes: Pre-launch fix F4 plus the both-arm half of F5 (worklog docs/worklogs/active/2026-10-16_prelaunch-fixes.md, M3; approved by the operator 2026-10-16 12:46 AM EDT). In bundle-v-control it is ON in both arms (onInBoth), so this standalone entry is for a later single-switch A/B only. Uses the finals incumbent (as stall-briefing does) because the supervisor half needs loop-guard-supervisor-v1. It acts on the first collapsed result that showed dialogue, which can come right after the new game starts.
